title: Coulthart detained by CBP after Grusch story

tellings.quote: Yeah, after I did the Grusch story, I was detained and held by CBP.

plain: Ross Coulthart, a journalist who reported on UFO secrecy, told podcast host Jesse Michels that after he broke the story of David Grusch, a former intelligence officer who said the government hides recovered non-human craft, he was stopped and held by US Customs and Border Protection, the agency that controls who enters the country. He places this in 2023 and tells it as a sign of pressure on him over that reporting.
